_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: George Egerton (Mary Chavelita Dunne, 1859-1945): Knut Hamsun's Hunger (1899; this is Knopf's 1920 text, which is bowdlerised). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 31); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

egerton-hamsun-hunger.note: Knopf's 1920 first printing. Gutenberg's other copy (8387, the 1921 eighth printing) notes that the Knopf text is a bowdlerised version of Egerton's 1899 translation; the unexpurgated 1899 Smithers edition is not on Gutenberg.

_excluded.pg-8387: Hunger again: the same Knopf text from its 1921 eighth printing; this shelf keeps the 1920 first printing (76692).

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker.
